owner: CC owns the disposition at deposit_survey, its proof, and the probe beside the survey machine. Akien owns nothing new here — this executes an asymmetry he already has on the record (survey_holdings_resolve's 2026-07-30 docstring) rather than proposing one.
state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> [TICKETME] -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(the_deposit_survives_a_move) -> PROVED
intention: deposit_survey disposes a holdings-resolve refusal through the forwarding order before it refuses, so a voyage that legitimately RETIRES an address can still teach its own survey tree — and a holding that resolves to nothing and has no forwarding record is still refused, loudly, exactly as today.
why: THE LIVED SYMPTOM: a voyage closes with 7 of its 8 chart berths deposited and no error anyone reads, because the survey deposit refused three hours after the survey door passed the same packet. The next similar request walks a survey tree that never learned this crossing, and the chart's dial reads a thin survey stratum with no way to tell thin from refused-at-the-door. THE MECHANISM, and it is an enumeration short by one rather than a wrong idea: judge_survey keeps a FLAT address-resolution rule on purpose, because it is the BERTH DOOR's mouth and 'at berth time every holding resolves by definition'; the PROMOTION sieve survey_holdings_resolve wraps it and filters through _resolves_to(address, ticket), because it 'alone stands downstream of a move'. There is a third mouth: deposit_survey calls validate_survey — the door's gate — and a deposit runs AFTER the build, which is the promotion side's stated condition word for word. So the deposit inherits a tolerance-free rule at the one moment the tolerance was written for.
traces_to: Law 1 — 'every answered question becomes structure; re-deriving a settled answer is a defect.' That an address moved is answered ONCE, on the ticket's forwarding record, by the hand or by the bulk-move derivation; a deposit that re-asks the filesystem and gets a stale no is re-deriving a settled answer and then discarding a learning because of it. Also Law 5: the deposit is how the chart's trees carry what a mind needs NOW, and a starved tree is the working surface failing at its own purpose.
gates: prove_gate: teeth beside the code at cairn/devices/builder/machines/survey/proofs/, sealed by TesterDevice under netns isolation through validation_store.persist_validation. build_gate: build_inspector's sieves at the PROVEME crossing. entry_gate: BUILDME refuses without a berthed validate packet claiming this ticket, plus intent_berth and sorted_berth. exit_gate: PROVED refuses without a complete passing verdict artifact against the claiming validate berth. emission_gate: the WATCHME crossing refuses unless cairn/devices/builder/machines/survey/probes/does_a_deposit_survive_a_move.py is berthed and armed. feeds_back_to_origin: the probe deposits to harbor_master and pokes; the back-edge is the owner's act (Law 6).
falsifier: TWO HALVES, AND BOTH ARE REQUIRED — the first alone is satisfied by deleting the judge, which is the hollow pass named before the build. (a) A survey berth whose ONLY holdings-resolve findings are all rescued by _resolves_to against the packet's own ticket deposits without refusal. (b) A berth with a holding that resolves to nothing and carries no forwarding record is STILL refused. NON-VACUITY: the fixture population is taken from the live berth corpus, not authored — measured at cast, 43 of 56 berths qualify for (a).
horizon: the seal expires when survey.py, inspector._resolves_to, or the forwarding-record shape changes. The watch's horizon is 1000 pulses — the placeholder every sibling probe carries, honest as a placeholder and dishonest as a measurement, to be re-tuned when the beat becomes a real number.

The sibling question was MEASURED rather than assumed: decompose validates `uses` against the survey berth's address SET (membership, not resolution) so it does not bite, and constrain/triage/hypothesize/validate carry no address-resolving judge. The one open design choice — whether the disposition sits in deposit_survey or in an explicit at-deposit mode of validate_survey — is the first act of BUILDME, not a dependency: the falsifier and the watch are identical under either seat.

watchme.trigger: read on demand, and materially after any voyage whose ticket carries a forwarding record — that population exists without arranging anything. Also after any edit to survey.py, judge_survey, or _resolves_to.
watchme.enough: ASYMMETRIC. ONE berth that the forwarding order fully rescues and the deposit still refuses is STRONG falsification and satisfies alone — the fix is present and did not take. Separately and equally strong: ONE berth with an unrescuable dead holding that the deposit ACCEPTS — that is the door loosened, the thing this ticket is bounded against. THREE consecutive non-vacuous readings with both counts at zero, at least one taken after a voyage that actually retired an address, is WEAK confirmation and also satisfies. A vacuous reading (berths_read == 0) counts toward neither and is itself a red.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, plus the probe's own readings: berths_read, refused-but-rescuable, dead-holding-accepted, and — the half a count cannot report — whether deposit_survey's disposition path is still WIRED, since a live fix and a reverted one print the same zero over a clean corpus.
watchme.nexus: survey — the tree this defect starves, and the only one that can say whether the deposits it should be receiving are arriving.
watchme.consumer: CC at the next voyage whose ticket carries a forwarding record, and the chart's dial, which reads the survey nexus aggregate and cannot today tell a thin stratum from one refused at the door.

Nothing here is a correction of a judgement; it is a census that was taken before the third caller existed.
